summary: LiveWire Group (through its wholly owned subsidiary LiveWire EV, LLC) acquired substantially all assets of Dust Motorcycles, Inc., covering electric motorcycle and dirt bike design, development, manufacturing, distribution, and powertrain technology. Consideration totals up to ~$14.0 million, comprising $375k cash, $500k in common stock at closing, three annual installments of $875k each in stock, and contingent earn-out payments of up to $11.25 million in stock. Shares valued using 30-day VWAP. The filing includes entry into a material definitive agreement and indemnification provisions. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for integration milestones, earn-out achievement, and stock-based dilution risk.
